environment during interval

  • CURIE: gmeow:environmentDuringInterval
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/environmentDuringInterval
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/sensory-environment

The time interval over which this SensoryEnvironment holds. For point-like environments, use gmeow:environmentAtInstant instead.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SensoryEnvironment -> gmeow:TimeInterval

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:environmentDuringInterval from gmeow:SensoryEnvironment to gmeow:TimeInterval when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:SensoryEnvironment, gmeow:TimeInterval
